recognize_zh: 這是胸部 X 光正面片（非型態圖）：心臟陰影明顯擴大、呈燒瓶狀，雙側下肺野有網狀間質陰影與肋膈角變鈍；在 CMML 病人中需考慮漿膜腔積液（如心包膜積液）或肺部浸潤等髓外表現。
features: Bilateral increased interstitial/reticular markings, more pronounced at the lung bases
Blunting of the costophrenic angles suggesting small pleural effusions
Radiopaque ring-shaped external object over the right upper hemithorax (external artifact)
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic image: a frontal chest radiograph. The cardiac silhouette is markedly enlarged with a globular configuration, and there are bilateral interstitial reticular opacities predominantly at the bases with blunting of the costophrenic angles, suggesting small pleural effusions. A ring-shaped external radiopaque object overlies the right upper chest. In a patient with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, a globular cardiac silhouette raises concern for pericardial effusion, and serosal effusions or pulmonary infiltration are recognized extramedullary manifestations; echocardiography and fluid cytology would be needed to confirm this.
